data.name: Stella
data.gender_notes: Stella is used as a female name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Latin stella, 'star'. Its root is Latin stella. A Christian name; borne by Saint Stella. Stella is a Latin name meaning “Star”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Stella expresses “Star”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Stella total 15, reducing to 6. Number 6 is associated with responsibility, care and harmony.
